what is java.en: Java is a high-level, object-oriented, platform-independent programming language.
what is java.te: Java anedi high-level, object-oriented, platform-independent programming language.

features of java.en: Java is simple, secure, portable, robust and multithreaded.
features of java.te: Java simple, secure, portable, robust mariyu multithreaded language.

applications of java.en: Java is used in web applications, mobile apps, enterprise systems and backend services.
applications of java.te: Java web applications, mobile apps, enterprise systems lo use chestaru.

variables in java.en: Variables are used to store data values with specific data types.
variables in java.te: Variables ante data values ni specific data types tho store cheyyadam.

data types in java.en: Java supports primitive and non-primitive data types.
data types in java.te: Java lo primitive mariyu non-primitive data types untayi.

operators in java.en: Java supports arithmetic, relational, logical and assignment operators.
operators in java.te: Java lo arithmetic, relational, logical operators untayi.

if else in java.en: if-else is used for decision making based on conditions.
if else in java.te: if-else conditions base chesi decision tiskovadaniki.

loops in java.en: Loops are used to execute a block of code repeatedly.
loops in java.te: Loops code ni repeat cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

for loop in java.en: for loop is used when the number of iterations is known.
for loop in java.te: for loop iterations count telisinappudu use chestaru.

while loop in java.en: while loop executes as long as the condition is true.
while loop in java.te: while loop condition true unna varaku run avutundi.

oops in java.en: OOPS in Java includes class, object, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation and abstraction.
oops in java.te: Java OOPS lo class, object, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, abstraction untayi.

class and object in java.en: Class is a blueprint and object is an instance of a class.
class and object in java.te: Class blueprint, object class yokka instance.

constructor in java.en: Constructor is a special method used to initialize objects.
constructor in java.te: Constructor object ni initialize cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

inheritance in java.en: Inheritance allows one class to acquire properties of another class.
inheritance in java.te: Inheritance ante oka class inkoka class properties tiskovadam.

polymorphism in java.en: Polymorphism allows methods to have same name with different behavior.
polymorphism in java.te: Polymorphism ante same method name, different behavior.

encapsulation in java.en: Encapsulation binds data and methods into a single unit.
encapsulation in java.te: Encapsulation data mariyu methods ni okate unit lo bind chestundi.

abstraction in java.en: Abstraction hides implementation details and shows only essential features.
abstraction in java.te: Abstraction internal details hide chesi essential features chupistundi.

exception handling in java.en: Exception handling manages runtime errors using try, catch and finally.
exception handling in java.te: Exception handling runtime errors ni handle cheyyadaniki.

multithreading in java.en: Multithreading allows multiple threads to run concurrently.
multithreading in java.te: Multithreading ante multiple threads okesari run avvadam.

java advantages.en: Java is secure, platform-independent and widely used in enterprise applications.
java advantages.te: Java secure, platform-independent mariyu enterprise applications lo popular.

java vs python.en: Java is statically typed while Python is dynamically typed.
java vs python.te: Java static typing, Python dynamic typing.

jvm jre jdk.en: JVM executes Java bytecode, JRE provides runtime environment, and JDK includes development tools.
jvm jre jdk.te: JVM bytecode execute chestundi, JRE runtime environment istundi, JDK development tools include chestundi.

java memory management.en: Java manages memory using heap, stack and garbage collection.
java memory management.te: Java heap, stack mariyu garbage collection dwara memory manage chestundi.

garbage collection in java.en: Garbage collection automatically removes unused objects from memory.
garbage collection in java.te: Garbage collection unused objects ni automatic ga memory nundi remove chestundi.

interfaces in java.en: Interface contains abstract methods and supports multiple inheritance.
interfaces in java.te: Interface abstract methods untayi mariyu multiple inheritance support chestundi.

abstract class in java.en: Abstract class can have abstract and non-abstract methods.
abstract class in java.te: Abstract class lo abstract mariyu normal methods untayi.

interface vs abstract class.en: Interface supports multiple inheritance, abstract class does not.
interface vs abstract class.te: Interface multiple inheritance support chestundi, abstract class cheyyadu.

collections framework in java.en: Collections framework provides classes like List, Set and Map to store data.
collections framework in java.te: Collections framework List, Set, Map lanti classes provide chestundi.

list set map in java.en: List allows duplicates, Set does not allow duplicates, Map stores key-value pairs.
list set map in java.te: List duplicates allow chestundi, Set allow cheyyadu, Map key-value pairs store chestundi.

arraylist vs linkedlist.en: ArrayList uses dynamic array, LinkedList uses doubly linked list.

hashmap vs hashtable.en: HashMap is not synchronized, Hashtable is synchronized.

exception hierarchy in java.en: Exception hierarchy includes Throwable, Exception and Error classes.
exception hierarchy in java.te: Exception hierarchy lo Throwable, Exception, Error classes untayi.

checked vs unchecked exception.en: Checked exceptions are checked at compile time, unchecked at runtime.
checked vs unchecked exception.te: Checked exceptions compile time lo check chestaru, unchecked runtime lo.

multithreading lifecycle.en: Thread lifecycle includes new, runnable, running, waiting and terminated states.
multithreading lifecycle.te: Thread lifecycle lo new, runnable, running, waiting, terminated states untayi.

synchronization in java.en: Synchronization controls access to shared resources in multithreading.
synchronization in java.te: Synchronization multithreading lo shared resources ni control chestundi.

deadlock in java.en: Deadlock occurs when two threads wait indefinitely for each other.
deadlock in java.te: Deadlock ante two threads okari kosam okaru forever wait cheyyadam.

java 8 features.en: Java 8 introduced lambda expressions, streams, functional interfaces and default methods.
java 8 features.te: Java 8 lo lambda expressions, streams, functional interfaces introduce chesaru.

lambda expressions in java.te: Lambda expressions anonymous functions ni short ga rayadaniki use chestaru.

streams api in java.en: Streams API is used to process collections in a functional style.
streams api in java.te: Streams API collections ni functional style lo process cheyyadaniki.
